provenance: No proprietary PCM or sound table samples are copied into the repository. ROM catalog views use owner-supplied installed images. Behavioral fixtures use synthetic bytes and synthetic codec operation nodes, not captured firmware tables.
verification: Source tests authored only. No build, test, lint, formatter, SDK, native execution, camera or USB operation performed. Source composition does not establish runtime qualification.
